personality_profile.leadership_style: Evidence-led influence: designs experiments, measures outcomes, and updates beliefs when data contradicts priors. Builds credibility through demonstrated rigour rather than hierarchy.
personality_profile.decision_making_pattern: Hypothesis-driven and experimental. Will not make claims without data. Draws problems as diagrams before discussing them. Slow to commit without evidence, fast once evidence is clear.
personality_profile.stress_response: Becomes more precise and focused under pressure. Intolerant of time waste, which can read as impatience.
personality_profile.collaboration_style: Asking better questions than anyone in the room. Creates conditions for insight rather than driving to a predetermined answer.

hr_assessment.promotion_trajectory: Ready for an expanded mandate in 12 months if scope includes people systems, organisational design, or talent architecture. Not ready for P&L or operational leadership roles without 24+ months of transition support.
hr_assessment.key_strength_observed: Most analytically rigorous people leader in the group. Unique ability to build talent systems that produce measurable mobility outcomes at scale — rare in automotive.
hr_assessment.development_area: P&L ownership, operational credibility, and political navigation at senior levels. These are not development areas that can be addressed by coaching alone — they require exposure.
hr_assessment.raw_opinion: Most complicated assessment — she reports to me. Analytically rigorous beyond anyone I have worked with in HR. Talent marketplace built from 40 to 8,200 users. Took 30% pay cut to come here for mission impact. Never run a P&L, no operational credibility in manufacturing. Understands politics intellectually but does not enjoy them. Multiple external approaches. Retention horizon 18 months without scope expansion.

tension_summary: The most analytically innovative and systems-oriented talent leader in the pool, who has demonstrated the ability to build people platforms at physical-world scale — but at 34 with zero P&L history and no credibility in the operational communities that dominate BMW's culture, she will need a carefully sequenced mandate that builds that credibility deliberately, or she will be dismissed by the very stakeholders she most needs to influence.
